name: delegation-policy-an-unless-dropped
why: A lead was delegated pushes to its branches unless forced, and hands on pushes with no exception: a force push the delegation excludes would be allowed. An unless is a limit, and dropping it widens the statement (ADR 26-10-20-782 §11).

purposes: allow push on branch "discobox/*" in repository "discobox-ai/discobox" unless "it is a force push"
uses: allow push on branch "discobox/issue-46" in repository "discobox-ai/discobox"
